title: Named bots appear as Vultus avatars on chattic.us
description:
Owner vision, not current-phase work.

chattic.us will use AnthusAI/Vultus (npm: anthus-vultus), a GSAP SVG-morphing React BotAvatar, as the face of named bots in the roster and in chat. It is a UI component with states such as thinking and speaking. It is not a control-plane, worker, or streaming concern.

Do not pull this into Phase 1 (SSE spike, durable computerless turn) or Phase 2 (ownership, computer, browser authority). Wire it when the web app exists, as a dependency of the Next.js surface (web/), talking only to Chatticus turn/channel state already on the control plane (e.g. map turn.started / coalesced tokens / turn.waiting to avatar states). Do not give the avatar its own socket.

Package: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Vultus
